title: Glass and Praxis
summary: High noble Houses of Alinor and Shimmerene's permit-quarter clerks clash with Thalmor Justiciars when abyssal geyser resonators begin fracturing the Crystal-Like-Law's lower ancestor vaults.

hook.rumour: Glass-wrights in Alinor and Shimmerene report hairline fractures creeping up the ancestor plinths each time the coastal abyssal geysers surge at high tide.
hook.notice: ALINOR CHANCERY & SHIMMERENE MONASTERY: Certified praxis-scholars and wardens sought to inspect the coastal geyser faults and lower tower vaults.

npcs.name: Warden of Alinor
npcs.greet: Glass-wrights in Alinor and Shimmerene report hairline fractures creeping up the ancestor plinths each time the coastal abyssal geysers surge at high tide.
talk: The trouble across Summerset Isle began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Alinor.
If you mean to help the High Kinship of Alinor, start by checking the trail between Alinor and Golden Gryphon Garret.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Alinor
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Golden Gryphon Garret is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Golden Gryphon Garret toward Alinor Royal Palace before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Alinor so High Kinlord Rilis-Auri can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Alinor Royal Palace
npcs.greet: You made good time from Golden Gryphon Garret. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Alinor Docks.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Alinor Docks with a picked guard.
Once Alinor Docks is cleared, return to Alinor to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Alinor
npcs.greet: High Kinlord Rilis-Auri awaits word on whether the crisis in Summerset Isle has been contained.
talk: The elders of Alinor have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Summerset Isle owes you a debt for standing between Alinor and ruin.
